card.name: Small words in opioid label phrases
card.fires_on: Short linking words or word pieces mid-phrase in opioid label text, mainly "from" in "differs from tolerance" and "any" in "can occur at any time".

modes.label: differs from
modes.description: The word "from" right after "differs" in the opioid-induced hyperalgesia definition.
modes.example: This condition differs<< from>> tolerance, which is the need for increasing

modes.label: at any time
modes.description: The word "any" after "occur at" in respiratory depression warnings.
modes.example: respiratory depression can occur at<< any>> time during the use of hydrom

modes.label: Partway through a word
modes.description: A word piece inside a longer term such as precipitate or cGVHD.

card.writes: The promoted tokens relate to "length", which does not clearly fit the text, so the output effect is unclear.
card.plain: It lights up on small connecting words in stock opioid label sentences, such as "differs from" and "at any time".
